Hi @amithash@meta.com,

After replacing ```pldm::utils::reportError``` with ```sdbusplus::error::com::meta::ipmi::UnifiedSEL::UnifiedSELEvent```, a few properties in the xyz.openbmc_project.Logging.Entry interface have changed:

- The SEL error message is now stored in the ```AdditionalData``` property

- The ```Message``` property now has the value ```com.meta.IPMI.UnifiedSEL.UnifiedSELEvent```

- The Severity level has changed from critical to error

Please let me know if anything is unexpected.
This should be good. The message will show up in the first arg.

Actually, I don't have much comments about the oem-meta code, because it is OEM code.
Jut make sure we follow OpenBMC C++ coding style.
I saw that Meta defined UnifiedSELEvent under IPMI, Is it ok when use an IPMI event for PLDM event?
IPMI is used to communicate with the host BIOS. When the host triggers events, the bridge IC on the host passes them to the BMC using the PLDM protocol. This is why SELEvent uses the ipmi prefix.
